information_shared: In: patches, firewall rules, DNS/auth data. Out: alerts and logs to SIEM
current_protection: Internal firewall with allowlist; proxies and tunneling
vulnerability: Compromised enterprise host uses an allowed flow or widens the allowlist; malicious patch arrives by design
who_can_disconnect: OT Network Security Manager; TMNA SOC

information_shared: Down: commands, setpoints, schedules, AGV tasks. Up: process values, alarms, historian data
current_protection: Internal firewall with allowlist; HMIs separated from PLCs
vulnerability: Industrial protocols carry no authentication; any host on a Control VLAN can write to a PLC

connection: R&D enclave -> Trusted Software Delivery / OT DMZ cluster
current_protection: No network link; dedicated encrypted devices wiped and verified on return
vulnerability: Nothing checks the package at the handoff; one bad transfer reaches vehicle and OT DMZ
who_can_disconnect: R&D Software Engineering Manager; Security Officer can refuse upload

connection: Trusted Software Delivery -> vehicle TPM -> Final QA
information_shared: Software package to vehicle; installed hash to vehicle database
current_protection: Encrypted wireless VLAN; TPM verification at boot; Final QA hash check
vulnerability: Tampered package is caught only after installation
who_can_disconnect: Automatic quarantine on hash mismatch; QA Manager escalation

connection: AGV management PLC <-> AGVs and pickers
information_shared: Delivery tasks out; device status back
current_protection: Unpublished encrypted SSID on own subnet/VLAN
vulnerability: Jamming or rogue access point stops AGVs
who_can_disconnect: OT Network Security Manager on Supply Chain Manager's decision

vulnerability: Bad inventory data still drives deliveries

connection: OT inspection probes -> Edge DMZ IDS/IPS
vulnerability: Compromised probe could bridge zones; Edge sensors don't parse industrial commands

information_shared: EDI orders, shipping notices, sequencing data
vulnerability: Ransomware on supplier link spreads inward or starves JIT sequencing
who_can_disconnect: TMNA SOC or OT Network Security Manager

connection: Equipment vendors <-> OT DMZ entry point (assumed)
